svg.aria-label: Rollcall. Attendance app for Camtech Volleyball Club, so a coach can run a session from a phone. One tap per player: present, late, excused, absent; Training and normal days tracked separately; Works offline and syncs when the signal returns; QR self check-in with an expiring code; Telegram session reports and CSV export; Co-coach access with row-level security. Built with React, Vite, Supabase, Vercel.
